name: TENNIS 40:40 HISTORY-FIRST v1.0 DRAFT · IN-PLAY SIGNAL + STATS · NEEDS PROVIDER

parameters.content:
## TENNIS "40:40 – DA" ADAPTATION · READ BEFORE ENABLING
This is a fresh in-play signal engine for the manual strategy "Будет в гейме счет 40:40 – ДА" (tennis, live/in-play), NOT a port of the football/hockey Module A pre-match Dixon-Coles engine — the market and the data shape are completely different (per-game deuce pattern inside a live match, not a pre-match goal model).

**Strategy criteria this encodes (from the source notes):**
1. Final or semifinal only (evenly matched opponents produce the pattern most reliably).
2. Watch at least 5-6 completed games before considering any signal (MIN_HISTORY_GAMES).
3. Work out which player's OWN service games keep reaching 40:40 — the bet is that the SAME thing happens on their very next service game. The default threshold (MIN_SIGNAL_RATE = 1.0) requires it to have happened in every one of that player's service games so far, matching the "always" language in the source notes and the worked example (2 out of 2 = 100%, flagged as an "ideal signal").

**What you still need to supply before this fires a live signal:**
1. A live tennis data feed with POINT-level detail per game (did this game reach 40:40 — i.e. deuce — at any point, plus current server and round), not just the final game score. Most cheap odds/score APIs only expose game-level scores; you need one with a point-by-point or "reached deuce" flag (e.g. Sportradar, BetsAPI, or another provider with live point feeds). API/KEY constants below are placeholders — nothing real is wired yet.
2. A Supabase table `tennis_4040_signals_v1` (columns roughly: id, match_id, tournament, round, player_a, player_b, server, opponent, game_number, set_number, games_played, server_samples, server_hit_rate, opponent_samples, opponent_hit_rate, odds_estimate, ideal_signal, status [pending/hit/miss], created_at, settled_at) — separate from the football/hockey settlement tables.
3. Your own Telegram bot credentials wired into a real Send node (not included here — this draft stops at building the message text) and, for the stats command, a Telegram Trigger with a filter on the "📊 Статистика сигналов" button/text.
4. A paper-trading period. The example in the source material is 5 signals (4 hits) — far too small a sample to trust; the "100% history → signal" heuristic and the reasoning-text thresholds are a reasonable encoding of the manual strategy but are UNVALIDATED at scale.

**Stats formulas (reproduce the existing bot's numbers exactly):**
- Winrate % = hits / total * 100
- Breakeven % = 1 / REFERENCE_ODDS * 100 (a configured reference price for this bet type, e.g. ~3.10 — NOT the average of the actual signal odds, which vary game to game)
- Edge over the line = Winrate % − Breakeven % (simple percentage-point difference)
These match the screenshot exactly: 80.0% winrate, 32.3% breakeven @3.10, +47.7% edge.

Until the four items above are in place, treat every output as a diagnostic, not a bet.
